response.answer: Aryan Deshwal is an assistant professor at the University of Minnesota, specializing in AI for high-performance computing. He focuses on optimizing AI algorithms for HPC applications and recently earned his PhD in computer science from Washington State University. His work aims to accelerate scientific discovery and engineering design.
